newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Value of Colombian pension funds up 6.9 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Value of Colombian pension funds up 6.9 pct in Feb.

text.p: Colombia's obligatory pension funds grew 6.9 percent to 931 billion pesos between January and the end of February, the banking superintendency reported Tuesday.
The number of people affiliated to pension plans grew 2 percent to 2.1 million in the same period, a statement by the superintendency said.

According to the latest figures, pension fund Porvenir, part of the Luis Carlos Sarmiento conglomerate, has 24 percent of the market, followed by Proteccion, part of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, with 21 percent and Colfondos, part of the Santo Domingo group with 17 percent.
The value of voluntary pension funds grew 4 percent in February compared to January to 83 billion pesos. The number of affiliates grew 5 percent to 16,262, the banking suiperintendency said.
